question: (1)/(20) is what percentage of (9)/(100) ? (Round off to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make denominators equal to compare directly: 1/20 = 5/100.

Here, the base is 9/100 and the value to check is 5/100.

Required % = (5/100 ÷ 9/100) × 100%

Required % = (5 / 9) × 100% ≈ 55.56%

**∴ The correct answer is 55.56%.**
